## Ray traversal (closest hit)

2000000 SAR-geometry rays (35 deg incidence from 693 km, clipped to the scene).

| Structure | Threads | Mrays/s |
|---|---|---|
| Binary BVH, object median | 1 | 0.89 |
| Binary BVH, SAH | 1 | 0.91 |
| 4-wide BVH (SSE), SAH | 1 | 1.31 |
| 8-wide BVH (AVX2), SAH | 1 | 1.56 |
| Binary BVH, SAH, coherent order | 1 | 2.73 |
| 4-wide BVH (SSE), SAH, coherent order | 1 | 3.43 |
| 8-wide BVH (AVX2), SAH, coherent order | 1 | 4.11 |
| Embree 4.3.0 (rtcIntersect1) | 1 | 2.42 |
| Embree, coherent order | 1 | 6.88 |

Embree build: 0.283 s (medium quality). Embree is 1.67x our best single-thread rate in coherent order (1.55x in random order). Closest hits agree on 100.000% of 100000 rays.

Hit rate: 98.7%. Random order is the cache-hostile worst case; the renderer traces in coherent order.

## Geometric render

Same terrain, 3 bounces, 2051 lines x 1992 bins, all 4 threads: 21941598 primary rays in 4.92 s (4.46 M primary rays/s, including shadow and bounce rays).
